en: Yo, Alice.  Huhhuhhuhhu.
Eep!  Disgusting!  Don't get too close.
Oh, dear Alice.  One shouldn't judge others by their appearance.
Sure.
(The disconnect between how he looks and how he acts frightens me though).
Now, I'm not going to do anything, so come over here.
I'm fine where I am.
(Who knows whether something would happen if I were to carelessly approach.)
I see.  That's too bad.
Yo, Alice.  Hello.
H-hello.
Come, let's have a leisurely chat this time.
I-I'm in a bit of a hurry, so maybe next time.
Why's that?  You're refusing again?
Good grief.  Young ladies these days simply have no manners.  *mumble mumble....*
(As I thought, scary!)
Hey, got a sec?
Do you need something?
Do you know anything about sacred items?
I'm unfamiliar.
Hey hold on!  Put a little more thought into it than that.  We're talking a matter of life and death here.
When I'm not familiar with something all I can say is "I'm unfamiliar".
Oh please don't leave it at that.  Any scrap of info would be great. Anything you've overheard?
.....Now that you mention it.
I recall hearing that someone has added an unusual book to their shop inventory.
An unusual book?
Probably meaning a holy book, a bible.
A holy book?!  Could that be one of the sacred items I need?!
Most likely.
So who is it then?  Who's selling it?
If I'm not mistaken it was on B26F....
On B26F right?  Got it!
....I'm not exactly certain about that though.
Hey now!  Don't do that!
How about you go find out?
A-all right.
